source.name: MLB.com press release – Cardinals announce Stifel as club's first jersey patch sponsor
source.note: The club's own announcement of a seven-year agreement starting with the 2023 season, so it covers this season. The patch is worn on the jersey sleeve. The live page blocks scripted access (403); the quote was verified on the Wayback Machine capture of 7 March 2026.
source.quote: As part of the new seven-year agreement starting this season, Stifel's logo will appear on the jersey sleeve of each of the Cardinals' four different on-field game uniforms.
